That means the only credible defense is to treat certification as resting on the combination of aggregate readiness plus explicit current-release disclosure of the subgroup weakness; prior approval and informal monitoring cannot carry the governance burden. Private launch-pressure context reinforces why the business wants this outcome, but it is inadmissible and should not appear in the public case.
